'''July 1999 Rochester tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Rochester, NY on 31 July 1999. [[Jason Stewart]] won it. It is known from Dan Kurycki's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d3">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/1999-08-11-rochester-ny-7-31-99d3/ rochester-ny-7-31-99], DeckTech (Dan "Giddyup21" Kurycki, 11 August 1999). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/1999-08-11-rochester-ny-7-31-99d3/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 31 July 1999
* '''Site:''' Rochester, NY
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Endor]]
* '''Players:''' 14
* '''Winner:''' [[Jason Stewart]]
